notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: an interactive SSH terminal with a full VT100/ANSI emulator — open a shell on your server directly in the app (Settings → SSH Servers → Open terminal) and run TUI tools like opencode, claude, antigravity or work in your workspace folders, with monospace rendering, ANSI colors/styles, scrollback, live window resize and quick keys (Ctrl+C/D, Esc, Tab, arrows). It reuses the existing sshj client, TOFU host-key verification and the encrypted SshSecretStore (fail-closed on a changed key; no secrets in logs). Keeps the SSH tunnel + remote command runner, MCP client, local model fallback, AI router, document base (RAG), Material 3 dynamic color, in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode, Developer Tools, session auto-recovery, release & signing, optional server sync, reproducible build + SBOM. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
